schedule.topic: Was East Asia a natural region—or historically made?
What can objects and inscriptions establish?
Can moral formation overcome violence and inequality?
Are people the problem, or political institutions?
Does an empire serve society or extract from it?
Why did empire fragment into durable political worlds?
Why did Buddhism flourish amid political division?
Copying China—or creating new political worlds?
Was Tang cosmopolitanism strength or instability?
Can regional order exist without universal empire?
Who gained from the Song transformation?
Why could the Mongols defeat richer states?
Did Mongol rule connect or harden East Asia?
Could governments control the markets they needed?
